asr_sentences.text: Hello friends, I hope you like my videos.

Friends, my YouTube channel name is Pharma Quality, so please view, like, comment and subscribe my channel to get the knowledge about the pharma quality standards and practices.
So now in this slide we will discuss what is 5Y analysis.
Basically, during any non-conformance, deviation out of specification or out of calibration results, 5Y tools can be used to identify the root cause.
A 5Y investigation is a systematic problem-solving technique used to identify the root cause of an issue.

So now we will discuss when 5Y analysis can be used; that is, the exact purpose of using 5Y.
First, it helps to identify the root cause of a problem, meaning you can find out the root cause of a nonconformance.
Second, it determines the relationship between different root causes of a problem.
That is, you can interpret the different cause with five why analysis.
Third is it is one of the simplest tools and easy to complete without any statistical analysis right so in this you do not need to have any statistical data to find out the root cause.
So now we will discuss how to use 5Y analysis.
First, write down the specific problem; writing the issue helps you to formalize the problem and describe it completely.
It also helps a team to focus on the same problem.

vision_scenes.description: 视频开场展示标题页，左侧深灰色箭头框内写有“5 Why Analysis”，右侧是一个流程图，显示五个标有“Why?”的蓝色方框逐级向下，最终指向一个黄色的“Root Cause!”圆圈，上方有大标题“5 Why?”。
画面切换至白色背景，左侧显示黑色文字“PHARMA QUALITY”，中间是YouTube标志。随后，一个红色的“subscribe”按钮和点击的手形图标出现在YouTube标志上方，提示观众订阅频道。
进入新幻灯片，标题为“What is 5-Why Analysis?”。右侧紫色背景上有许多白色问号和一把放大的黄色放大镜。左侧依次出现三个要点，解释5-Why分析是一种通过反复问“为什么”来识别问题根本原因的系统性解决问题的技术。
幻灯片标题变为“When to use a 5-Why Analysis?”。右侧是一个浅蓝色背景上的巨大3D白色问号。左侧列出使用场景：帮助识别问题的根本原因、确定不同根本原因之间的关系，以及指出这是一种无需统计分析的简单工具。
幻灯片标题为“How to use 5-Why Analysis?”。页面展示了四个步骤，配有图标：1. 写下具体问题；2. 问为什么发生并写下答案；3. 如果答案不是根本原因，继续问为什么；4. 循环直到团队确认识别出根本原因。红色激光笔在文字上移动进行讲解。
展示案例分析幻灯片，标题为“Example: Application of 5 Why Investigation”。问题是“制造工厂的机器故障”。流程图展示了5个为什么的推导过程：机器故障->过热->缺乏定期维护->人员不足->预算限制->运营费用削减。红色激光笔沿着流程图路径移动。
视频最后展示结束页，白色背景上有彩色的手绘风格字体“Thank You”，周围有蓝色边框装饰。
